snap_upstate_case_last_digit.program: SNAP — Upstate (all counties except NYC five boroughs)
snap_upstate_case_last_digit.summary: Outside New York City, SNAP benefits are generally available based on the last digit of the case number (1st–9th of the month).
notes: This mapping applies to Upstate NY / non-NYC counties per USDA FNS.
NYC cases use a separate six-month published schedule that changes month to month — see the NYC official schedule link in citations. This calculator does not invent NYC dates.
